findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_sources, get_source, list_categories, list_articles, get_article, list_changes, get_protocol_facts, get_sdk_security, get_support_info, get_trust_checklist, list_datasets, get_dataset, list_bots, get_bot, request_missing_data, submit_review, get_reviews, check_payment_endpoint, get_verification_status, list_alert_topics · Private data: list_categories, get_article, list_changes, get_protocol_facts, get_sdk_security, get_support_info, get_trust_checklist, list_datasets, get_dataset, list_bots, get_bot, request_missing_data, submit_review, get_reviews, check_payment_endpoint · Public sink: get_sdk_security, request_missing_data, submit_review, get_verification_status, create_alert, list_alert_topics · Destructive: list_datasets, get_dataset, check_payment_endpoint.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
